mcp_tools.name: create_task
mcp_tools.description: Create a TMF630 Part 4 async Task resource for a long-running operation. Returns the task_id and href for polling. Use poll_task_status to check completion.

related_entity_id.description: Optional ID of the resource this task operates on.

mcp_tools.name: poll_task_status
mcp_tools.description: Poll the status of a TMF630 async Task by task_id. Returns current status and percent_progress.

mcp_tools.name: create_import_job
mcp_tools.description: TMF630 Part 7: Create a bulk ImportJob to ingest a batch of resource instances from a remote URI or uploaded file. Returns import_job_id for polling.

content_type.description: MIME type of the import payload.

source_uri.description: URI of the remote file to import (https:// or file://).

mcp_tools.name: create_export_job
mcp_tools.description: TMF630 Part 7: Create a bulk ExportJob to export matching resource instances. Supports SPARQL/SQL filter query. Returns export_job_id and download URL when complete.

query.description: Optional SQL or SPARQL filter restricting exported records.
